title: Realizability-preserving finite element discretizations of the $M_1$ model for dose calculation in proton therapy
summary: We present a deterministic framework for proton therapy dose calculation based on finite element discretizations of the energy-dependent $M_1$ moment model. The nonlinear $M_1$ system is derived from the Fokker--Planck equation for charged particles and closed using an entropy-based approximation of the second moment. Energy is treated as a pseudo-time coordinate. The zeroth and first moments of the proton fluence are evolved backward in energy.
